fun_facts: Carnell Tate is from Chicago. He attended Marist High School before finishing high school at IMG Academy.
He enjoys Legos and video games; his listed favorite is Call of Duty.
In Ohio State’s 2024 national championship season, he started all 15 games and caught 52 passes for 733 yards and four touchdowns.
As a junior, he earned first-team Academic All-American honors with a 3.50 GPA while majoring in sport industry.
He finished his Ohio State career with 121 catches, 1,872 yards and 14 touchdowns; his catches and yards ranked 18th in school history, and his touchdowns ranked 26th.

## Carnell Tate

• He played in 39 games between 2023-25, started 26 and finished his Ohio State career with 121 receptions for 1,872 yards and 14 touchdowns

• He ranks 18th in both receptions and yards at Ohio State and 26th in touchdowns

• Had a reception in 37 of the 39 games in which he played

• Despite missing three games in 2025 because of injury, Tate was a force on the playing field with 51 receptions for 875 yards, a 17.2 yards-per reception average with nine touchdowns

• Tate was also a force off the field in 2025: he was a first-team Academic All-American as selected by the College Sports Communicators with a 3.50 grade point average while majoring in sport industry • He is the 33rd Ohio State football player to earn first-team Academic All-America honors • 15 of Tate's starts came as a sophomore during the Buckeyes' national championship season of 2024
